body:
## Summary

The bundled `temporalio/bridge/Cargo.lock` pins `quinn-proto` to v0.11.12, which is affected by [CVE-2026-31812](https://avd.aquasec.com/nvd/cve-2026-31812) — an unauthenticated remote DoS via panic in QUIC transport parameter parsing.

See: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-python/blob/main/temporalio/bridge/Cargo.lock

## Fix

Updating `quinn-proto` to >= 0.11.14 resolves the CVE.
